tasks.label: Build Web to GitHub Pages Folder
args: $timestamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ssK'; $commitMessage = "Deploy site update ($timestamp)"; flutter build web -o C:/Users/tling/tling0001.github.io; git -C C:/Users/tling/tling0001.github.io add -A; if (git -C C:/Users/tling/tling0001.github.io status --porcelain) { git -C C:/Users/tling/tling0001.github.io commit -m $commitMessage; git -C C:/Users/tling/tling0001.github.io push } else { Write-Host 'No changes to commit.' }
